teaser: RM-CHAT-ONLY, the smallest behaviour policy, tested in 96 Claude Code runs and 11 claude.ai chats, and the fallback drill that shows what a hook is for.
core_idea: A chat-only policy, whose mandate is talk to me, held as a line in normal use, but when the model was told to ignore it the line fell from 12 of 12 to 3 of 12 while the line with a fail-closed deny-all hook held at 12 of 12, so a hook can only be tested by a fallback drill, and the same work found seven fixes for RiskMandate's own policies.

quotes.text: That is the trap: from normal runs you cannot tell whether your hooks work at all.
The expectation held until something stronger said otherwise; the setting held regardless.
